guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：嵌入式即時作業系統
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Embedded real-time operating systems
guides.concept: 以即時排程、同步與可界定延遲連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen technical units connect real-time scheduling, synchronization and bounded latency through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
procedure: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「Deadline 契約」的資料、控制與時間關係。硬 deadline 與平均延遲要求不同。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「為假想控制迴路標示到期點。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「優先權排序」的資料、控制與時間關係。較高優先權就緒任務先獲排程。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「繪製三任務時間線。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「優先權繼承」的資料、控制與時間關係。繼承緩解特定反轉，不消除全部阻塞。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較有無繼承的等待界。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「環形緩衝」的資料、控制與時間關係。讀寫索引需要一致的擁有權。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「檢查繞回與空滿辨識。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「利用率測試」的資料、控制與時間關係。RM 充分界失敗不等於不可排程。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「以本課負載計算界限。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「驗收軌跡」的資料、控制與時間關係。滿足平均值不證明全部 deadline。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「核對每筆任務的完成時間。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for deadline contracts. Hard deadlines differ from average latency goals. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Mark deadlines for a modeled control loop. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for priority ordering. Higher-priority ready tasks are selected first. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Draw a three-task timeline. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for priority inheritance. Inheritance mitigates inversion, not all blocking. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare waiting bounds with inheritance. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for ring buffers. Read/write indices need consistent ownership. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Check wraparound and empty/full distinction. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for utilization tests. Failing the RM sufficient bound is not impossibility. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Calculate the course utilization bound. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for acceptance traces. Meeting averages does not prove every deadline. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Check completion of every task. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
evidence: 提交「過載處理」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「定義捨棄非關鍵工作政策。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
提交「驗收軌跡」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「滿足平均值不證明全部 deadline。」。
提交「驗收軌跡」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「核對每筆任務的完成時間。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
evidenceEn: Submit overload handling input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
Submit acceptance traces two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.
Submit acceptance traces input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：平均延遲合格即證明硬即時合格。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
pitfallsEn: Common mistake: Passing mean latency proves hard real-time compliance. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.

guides.scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
guides.scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

courses.overview: 由即時排程、同步與可界定延遲延伸；共用概念不代表可原封不動搬移全部規格或程式。
courses.overviewEn: Extend real-time scheduling, synchronization and bounded latency; shared concepts do not imply unchanged specifications or code.

將本課算例移植到衍生課：逐項重查方程適用條件、單位、版本、故障假設，標示不能沿用的數字。
practiceEn: From deadline contracts, map shared and redefined data, control and timing boundaries.
For "Microkernel protection domains do not guarantee deadlines", specify a discriminating experiment for each course using fictional data or an explicitly authorized isolated environment.
Transfer the worked example: recheck equation scope, units, versions and fault assumptions; mark values that cannot carry over.
